content.comment_body: If you use [product_name] Web Editor: The custom pages you build with the Web Editor will be accessible via the integrated web server within the [product_name] device. The pages form a complete project that's uploaded to the [product_name]. Note: You need the latest [product_name] version [version_no] and [product_name] software [version_no].

Hello, I'm planning to use a [product_name] module for thermal control. Besides managing the parameters locally with a touch panel, I would like to create a web application using [product_name] tools. Is it possible for the touch panel and LAN/web connection to operate at the same time? Has anyone done this before? Thanks in advance.
Yes, I have [product_name] version [version_no] and [product_name] software [version_no]. My concern is whether I can connect both the operator panel and the web application at once.
You can achieve this, but you'll need to use a network switch since the [product_name] device has only one Ethernet port.
Thank you! I will give it a try.
Moderation has moved your posts to a separate topic: [product_name] web application and touch panel. Did you not receive a personal message from the moderator?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring how to use both a touch panel and a web-based application to manage thermal control on [product_name] hardware. The main concern is whether local and remote operation can happen simultaneously, as the hardware includes only a single Ethernet port. Solutions such as using a network switch are suggested to allow dual connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that [product_name] hardware can allow simultaneous connections for both a touch panel and a web application, enabling management of parameters locally and remotely without network conflicts.
